meta.title: Mochi Notes
meta.reviewed: Reviewed by hand after extract_style.py: fonts, characters, dataViz, type scale/weights, BPM, post grain, caption band and flavor swatches changed; rationale cites the evidence ids in style-extract.md (committed copy of build/style-extract.md).

source.notes: product README: emoji-dense, short exclamatory lines, conversational second person; tagline, features, how-it-works example, flavors table, fictional-project disclaimer
logo lockup: app-icon tile with the plush strawberry mochi + two-tone Nunito Black wordmark (ink + strawberry)
the demo web app: CSS colour/font/radius tokens, flavor themes (.app[data-flavor]), real UI captured with tools/capture_ui.mjs
Nunito variable font (wght 200-1000), SIL OFL 1.1 (source/fonts/OFL.txt); the app and logo face

rationale.palette: Light theme: all background evidence is light (23.4 vs 0.0) [E23, E24]. Roles are the app's own tokens [E7]: bg #FFF7F2 (--bg), bg2 #FDEBEF (--bg-soft), surface #FFFFFF, ink #46303D (--text, also the logo wordmark [E2]), accent #FF8FAF (--primary, <meta theme-color> [E4]), accent2 #B9A3F3 (--secondary, ube), accent3 #92D2A6 (--tertiary, matcha). ok/warn/deny are the app tokens darkened to 3:1 on bg by the extractor. muted #7F6E73 is the draft's derived #9D8C91 (3.0:1) lifted to 4.5:1 on bg, because it sets the on-screen disclaimer (every text role reaches 4.5:1). accent is 2.0:1 on bg: fills, glows and the mascot only; small accent text uses accentInk #B84F71 (4.5:1); display-size accent words use accentStrong #E2567D (--primary-strong, the logo's "Notes" [E2, E7], 3.2:1 = AA large). Extra swatches strawberry/matcha/ube/yuzu are the four flavor primaries of source/app.html (--primary in :root and in .app[data-flavor] blocks, read by hand: the extractor reads root tokens only); the code-drawn mascot takes its body colours from them. Their text-strength partners strawberryInk/matchaInk/ubeInk/yuzuInk are the same blocks' --primary-strong tokens (the app's button and pill colours), used for flavor names on screen.
rationale.type: Nunito everywhere, as in the material: @font-face + --font/--font-display tokens [E5, E6, E8, E9] and the logo wordmark [E2]. The extractor named the variable file's default instance ("Nunito ExtraLight") as the display face; corrected to the family "Nunito" with one fonts.files entry (wght 200-1000, OFL [E21]) so MP4 and HTML embed the same face. displayWeight 900 (the app's headings and the logo are Nunito Black), bodyWeight 700 (the app sets body copy at 700-800). Scale widened for motion type (18-144 px at 1080p): headlines 88-112, wordmark 144, chips 26-32; tracking -0.015 em on headlines, 0.09 em on small labels.
rationale.motion: Energy 0.90 and playful 0.96 [E1: ‘!’ 38.6/1k, emoji 104/1k, 6 words/sentence] -> energetic pace with a bouncy underdamped spring (f 2.86, z 0.41), overshoot 1.8, outBack. Transitions by score: blobWipe, zoomInto (there is real app UI to dive into), whip, portalFlash, match; this reel uses blobWipe, match and zoomInto. characters: true (changed): the logo's mochi is the brand's named helper ("Mochi, your squishy little helper" [E1, E2]), so it acts; it is drawn in code from the logo and registered like a cutout. dataViz: false (changed): the 0.35 data score came from a flavors table and times like "3pm", not from data.
rationale.sound: bright-pop scored 1.01 (next lofi 0.46) from warm 0.88, playful 0.96, dark 0 [E1, E7]. The draft said 123 BPM; set to 120 (same preset range 112-124, same energetic feel) so the 30 s cut is exactly 15 bars and every bar is 120 frames at 60 fps; the short cut is 7 bars = 14 s. Key C major (from the accent hue, free choice), full drums, glassy SFX.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a playful consumer launch, 259 words of short exclamatory copy, no claims that need explaining [E1, E3]; the reel is music-led and every idea is on screen as type. If narration is wanted: Puck with [bright, playful], en-US, conversational register, captions on (see README "Narration on"). Captions (narration on only) sit in a one-line band centred at y 1040 px that every scene keeps free (the drafted y 960 crossed the chips, Mochi and the flavor names).
rationale.visuals: Carriers: code-drawn vector (always), the mascot as cutout-style sprites (drawn in code from the logo [E2]: four flavor variants + blink, happy and thinking poses), and real app UI captured from source/app.html with tools/capture_ui.mjs (bubble with text rows for typing, progress states on a static clone, result card, flavor themes). web-shots dropped: the README page itself adds nothing the app capture does not show.
